abstract: For the $n$-step Syracuse random variable $\mathrm{Syrac}_n = \sum_{m=1}^n 3^{m-1} 2^{-s_m} \pmod{3^n}$ with characteristic function $\chi_n(\xi)$ and primitive mean square $E_n$, we establish four results on its fine-scale Fourier analysis and stopping-shell correlations. First, along the Hull--Dobell orbit $y_t = (4^t - 1)/3 \bmod 3^{n-1}$, we prove an exact Parseval isometry equating $\frac{2}{3} 3^{n-1} E_{n-1}$ to the primitive Fourier energy of $q_{n-1}(t) = \mathbb{P}(\mathrm{Syrac}_{n-1} \equiv y_t)$, giving $3^2 E_2 = 5/7$ and self-contained Cauchy--Schwarz bounds $E_n/E_{n-1} \ge 7/27$ ($n \ge 3$) and $E_n/E_{n-1} \ge 18581/69905$ ($n \ge 4$). Second, for $\tau_j = \min\{m \ge 1 : s_m > j\}$, we prove $\tau_j - 1 \sim \mathrm{Binomial}(j, 1/2)$; evaluated in exact rationals on the certified $\overline{|\chi_\ell(1)|}$ table ($\ell \le 1000$) of `collatz_2/v2`, this sharpens [2, Corollary 3] by $62.2\times$--$110.7\times$ and extends [2, Corollary 3] (with constant $40$) to $n \le 2394$ for $j \ge \max(0, 2n - 1001)$ via binomial reflection symmetry. In the coordinate $t_r = j - s_{n-r+1}$, the renewal kernels satisfy a Quarter-Plane Twisted Pascal PDE with a dual backward adjoint recurrence and a Skip-Free Cold-Triangle Defect Formula for $d_0 \le 0$. Third, unrolling $\chi_r(2^{-s}\xi)$ by $m$ horizontal steps with terminal boundary $1$ yields a nonnegative majorant hierarchy $\widetilde{\eta}_r^{(m)}(s; \xi) \ge |\chi_r(2^{-s}\xi)|$ whose continuum polynomial has circle-average $L^2(\mathbb{T})$ saddle rate $1/\sqrt{3} < \log_2(3/2)$ at slope $3/4$ by Tao's injectivity lemma, while an exact phase-transition formula $I_{\mathrm{eff}}(\rho)$ analyzes the constant-base model convolution $\mathcal{R}_n(\rho)$. Fourth, we prove exact top-shell cancellation $\Sigma_{\mathrm{diag}}^{(P)}(f) = \mathcal{B}_P(f) - \mathcal{Q}_P^-(f)$ and an unconditional $O(1/m)$ modular-injectivity bound on $\mathcal{Q}_P^-(f)$. These results do not establish universal Collatz convergence, deterministic plaquette re-pinning, or an all-$\xi$ exponential bound on $|\chi_n(\xi)|$.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Addressed all five points in the referee report on Yur6VYhhK15j8Ynm: (1) Removed the unproved continuum Milne boundary-layer, scattering-asymptotic, and two-stage crossover section (formerly Section 5), retaining only the exact algebraic Cramer-tilt zero-drift identity in Theorem 3.3(1) and the corrected quadratic binomial curvature expansion -\frac{\lambda}{2(\lambda-1)}\frac{\ell^2}{n} - \frac{(2-\lambda+2\delta)\ell}{2(\lambda-1)n} in Remark 3.2. (2) Corrected all declared domains and signs in Section 3: replaced \min(n,j) by \max(1, n-j) \le \ell \le n in Theorem 3.1(1) (verified for all 1 \le n \le 7, 0 \le j \le 20 including j=0 and j<n), matched collatz_2's positive tilt convention \theta^* = \ln\frac{\lambda}{2(\lambda-1)} > 0 throughout Theorem 3.1(2), and restricted Theorem 3.4 (Cold-Triangle Defect Formula) to d_0 \le 0 so (0,0) \in \mathcal{T}_{d_0} (verified across d_0 \in \{-3,-2,-1,0\}). (3) Clarified the scope of Section 4: credited Tao [1, Lemma 6.2] for the 2-adic valuation-peeling injectivity in Theorem 4.2(1), stated explicitly that the circle-average L^2(\mathbb{T}) saddle rate is not a pointwise bound (e.g., at \theta=0) and does not prove deterministic re-pinning, and framed Theorem 4.3 strictly as an exact analysis of the constant-base model convolution \mathcal{R}_n(\rho). (4) Corrected the related-work account (quadratic upper bound O(n^2), linear lower bound, and failure of L^2 regularity in El Jaouhari [3] and collatz_9 [4]; credited [2, Sec. 3.2] for the O(nj) forward pass and [3, Sec. 5.4] for the one-step density relation; fixed exact titles of [3, 6, 7]) and fixed the conjugate-symmetry factor 2 in Theorem 2.2 (E_{n-1} = \|D_{n-1}\|_2^2/3, E_n = 5\|R_n\|_2^2/3). (5) Updated verify_paper5.py and supplement.zip to compute Tables 2 and 3 in exact rational arithmetic directly from collatz_2's certify_chi1.txt with zero dropped terms, and Table 4 with the rigorous terminal boundary \widetilde{\eta}_r^{(m)}(S_{\max}; \xi) = 1.
title: Additive-to-Multiplicative Parseval Isometry, Quarter-Plane Twisted Pascal Green's Functions, and m-Step Horizontal Plaquette Majorants for the Syracuse Characteristic Function
